basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Administrative Officer & Media Officer Posts
basic_details.organization_name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Rishikesh (AIIMS Rishikesh)
basic_details.short_information: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Rishikesh (AIIMS Rishikesh) has officially announced the Administrative Officer and Media Officer Recruitment 2026 with 2 openings. The detailed notification has been published at https://aiimsrishikesh.edu.in/. Candidates who are up to 35 years of age and hold a First Class Master's degree in Public Health, Hospital Administration, Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Media Studies, Communication, Development Communication, or another relevant discipline can submit their email applications up to 30 July 2026. age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data.

qualification.details: Administrative Officer: 1st Class Masters in Public Health/ Masters of Hospital Administration/Relevant to Public Health; 5-8 years of experience in a progressive role; Ability to design and execute independent research studies/policy-centered work; Ability to work in a diverse inter-disciplinary environment and provide guidance to other members. Media Officer (Media): Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Media Studies, Communication, Public Health/Health Beat, Development Communication or a related discipline from a recognized university; Experience in Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs), nutrition, hypertension, Front-of-Package Labeling (FOPL), health systems, or policy advocacy projects; Knowledge of India's public health system and national health programmes, particularly NP-NCD and hypertension control initiatives; Experience working with media advocacy campaigns at state or national levels; Familiarity with media monitoring, analytics, and communication impact assessment.

salary_details.details: Administrative Officer: Rs. 50000 Per Month Media Officer (Media): Rs. 70000 Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-07-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Administrative Officer and 1 for Media Officer (Media).

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Administrative Officer: 1st Class Masters in Public Health/ Masters of Hospital Administration/Relevant to Public Health; 5-8 years of experience in a progressive role; Ability to design and execute independent research studies/policy-centered work; Ability to work in a diverse inter-disciplinary environment and provide guidance to other members. Media Officer (Media): Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Media Studies, Communication, Public Health/Health Beat, Development Communication or a related discipline from a recognized university; Experience in Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs), nutrition, hypertension, Front-of-Package Labeling (FOPL), health systems, or policy advocacy projects; Knowledge of India's public health system and national health programmes, particularly NP-NCD and hypertension control initiatives; Experience working with media advocacy campaigns at state or national levels; Familiarity with media monitoring, analytics, and communication impact assessment.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Administrative Officer: Rs. 50000 Per Month Media Officer (Media): Rs. 70000 Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-07-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Rishikesh Administrative Officer / Media Officer posts is 30th July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Administrative Officer / Media Officer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Administrative Officer and Media Officer positions at AIIMS Rishikesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Administrative Officer position, a 1st Class Masters in Public Health, Masters of Hospital Administration, or a related field is required, along with 5-8 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Media Officer post?
faq.answer: The Media Officer position offers a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Administrative Officer and Media Officer posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a Written Exam followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application and required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Rishikesh (AIIMS Rishikesh).

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Rishikesh.
